verdict.rationale: Secureframe runs several built-in background automations: daily continuous monitoring with failing-test alerts, automated evidence collection across 100+ integrations, automatic shadow-IT detection via SSO, and user-configured recurring access and vendor reviews with reminders and Jira/Slack tasks. These are fixed, pre-built compliance routines rather than automations a user designs, and the AI features (Comply AI for risk, policies, vendor questionnaires) are user-invoked rather than autonomous background agents. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder with custom triggers and actions, autonomous AI agents acting in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
